introHtml: Full color decoration brings your brand to life on bath and body products like lotions, soaps, and gift sets. Unlike single-color imprints, full color allows for photorealistic logos, gradients, and intricate designs that make your corporate gifts stand out. Whether you're creating welcome kits for new hires or holiday gifts for clients, full color printing on bath products ensures your branding looks vibrant and professional. Common decoration methods include digital transfer and screen printing, both of which produce sharp, lasting results on various packaging materials.
